categories.name: Glassware
categories.description: Vessels, containers, and transfer glass instruments used for containment, mixing, reaction, and liquid transfer.

categories.name: Basic Tools and Consumables
categories.description: Everyday handling tools, sampling utensils, weighing boats, droppers, and consumable supplies.

categories.name: Heating Equipment
categories.description: Thermal apparatus used for heating, evaporation, temperature control, and combustion.

categories.name: Support Equipment
categories.description: Hardware used to mount, hold, clamp, support, and stabilize lab equipment during experimental procedures.

categories.name: Separation Equipment
categories.description: Apparatus dedicated to physical separation techniques such as filtration, distillation, centrifugation, and liquid-liquid extraction.

categories.name: Measuring Instruments
categories.description: Precision and general instruments measuring physical quantities including mass, temperature, density, and refractive index.

categories.name: Safety Equipment
categories.description: Personal protective equipment (PPE), emergency stations, safety containment devices, and waste disposal units.

categories.name: Cleaning and Storage
categories.description: Equipment and supplies for washing, maintaining, drying, and preserving sensitive samples and tools.

categories.name: pH and Analytical Instruments
categories.description: Analytical devices and indicators for determining pH, optical absorbance, color intensity, and electrical conductivity.

categories.name: Observation and Optical Instruments
categories.description: Optical and magnifying instruments used for visual inspection, sample observation, and crystal morphology examination.
